fields.System.Title: OUT-606 — Partial shipment of an order
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a shipping clerk, I want to ship what is ready and leave the rest outstanding, so
that a customer who accepts partials is not made to wait for one backordered line.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a customer who allows partial shipment, then the packed portion can ship while
  • the rest stays open.
  • - Given a customer who does not, then the order cannot ship until complete.
  • - Given a partial shipment, then the order status is partly shipped, distinct from
  • both shipped and packed.
  • - Given the shipped portion, then its reservations are consumed and the outstanding
  • portion keeps its reservations.
  • - Given the ERP notification, then it states which lines and quantities shipped.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | order, order_line, shipment, reservation |
| Risks | Partial shipment leaving a state nothing downstream handles ([doc 04 §3.5](../../../docs/04-modules.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
